title: Nonnegativity of restricted Fourier weight
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $J$ be a finite set of coordinates, and let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$. The restricted Fourier weight of $f$ on $J$ at $S$ is nonnegative.
